manufacturer: WEMOS (Quanzhou weimosi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.)
package: plug-in board 34.2 × 25.6 mm, 2 × 8 pins at 2.54 mm, USB-C, I2C connector SH1.0 4P

1.name: RST
1.hint: EXT_RSTB, low active: 12 kΩ to +3V3 (R7), reset button with 100 nF to GND, auto-reset from the CH340C through UMH3N; JP1 (open) joins it through 470 Ω to IO16 for deep-sleep wake-up (schematic)

2.name: A0
2.hint: TOUT through the divider 220 kΩ (R12) / 100 kΩ (R13): the ESP8266EX ADC reads 0–1.0 V at TOUT, the product page gives 3.2 V max at A0

3.name: IO16
3.hint: GPIO16 (XPD_DCDC): deep-sleep wake-up when joined to EXT_RSTB (JP1); the product page: interrupt/PWM/I2C/one-wire not supported on this pin

7.name: IO15
7.hint: MTDO: HSPI_CS, UART0_RTS, I2SO_BCK; boot-mode pin (ESP8266EX datasheet note to table 2-1: GPIO2, GPIO0 and MTDO select the boot mode); 12 kΩ to GND on the board (R11)

8.name: +3V3
8.hint: output of the ME6211C33 LDO (from VBUS), 10 µF; the ME6211's current rating was not read

9.name: TX
9.hint: U0TXD (GPIO1) through 470 Ω (R8), also to the CH340C RXD; must not be pulled low during power-up (ESP8266EX table 2-1 note)

10.name: RX
10.hint: U0RXD (GPIO3), driven by the CH340C TXD on the board (schematic); I2SO_DATA (ESP8266EX table 4-5)

11.name: IO5
11.hint: GPIO5: SCL of the board's I2C port (product page, P1) – I2C is software on the ESP8266EX (datasheet 4.4)

12.name: IO4
12.hint: GPIO4: SDA of the board's I2C port (product page, P1) – I2C is software on the ESP8266EX (datasheet 4.4)

13.name: IO0
13.hint: GPIO0 (SPI_CS2); boot-mode pin (ESP8266EX datasheet note to table 2-1: GPIO2, GPIO0 and MTDO select the boot mode); 12 kΩ to +3V3 (R9), pulled low by the auto-reset transistor (UMH3N) for flashing

14.name: IO2
14.hint: GPIO2: U1TXD, I2SO_WS; boot-mode pin (ESP8266EX datasheet note to table 2-1: GPIO2, GPIO0 and MTDO select the boot mode); 12 kΩ to +3V3 (R10) and the blue LED with 2 kΩ to +3V3 (on when low)

16.name: VBUS
16.hint: USB-C VBUS, input of the ME6211C33 LDO (10 µF); the ME6211's input rating was not read

usb_c.source: LOLIN D1 mini schematic V4.0.0 (sch_d1_mini_v4.0.0.pdf, wemos.cc): R1 and R2, 5.1 kΩ from CC1 and CC2 to GND

hints: I2C and PWM are software on the ESP8266EX (datasheet 4.4, 4.7): they work on other GPIOs too – a net with fn i2c or pwm finds no hardware function here; leave fn out on bit-banged nets
the ESP8266EX datasheet v7.1 is marked NRND; Espressif recommends the ESP8684

radio.source: Espressif ESP8266EX Datasheet v7.1 (marked NRND, 2025.11): table 1-1 (2.4–2.5 GHz, 2400–2483.5 MHz; 802.11b +20 dBm), table 5-4 (PA output power 11b mode 19.5/20.5/21.5 dBm min/typ/max, input frequency 2412–2484 MHz); EU declaration of conformity LOLIN D1 MINI, 2026-02-07 (wemos.cc, read 2026-10-31)

compliance.source: RoHS: certificate of conformity FTC26056002-1, ZhongShan Forever Testing, 2026-02-05 (RoHS 2011/65/EU & (EU) 2015/863), wemos.cc, read 2026-10-31; the EU declaration of conformity of 2026-02-07 names the RoHS and EMC directives (2014/30/EU) and EN 55032/55035 – it names no radio directive

sources: LOLIN D1 mini schematic V4.0.0 (sch_d1_mini_v4.0.0.pdf, wemos.cc) (read 2026-10-31, KiCad drawing): J2 1–8 RST, A0, IO16, IO14 (SCK), IO12 (MISO), IO13 (MOSI), IO15, +3V3; J3 1–8 TX, RX, IO5 (SCL), IO4 (SDA), IO0, IO2, GND, VBUS; U1 ESP8266, U2 ME6211C33 (VBUS → +3V3, 10 µF in and out), U4 CH340C, U5 UMH3N auto-reset; CHIP_EN 12 kΩ (R4) and EXT_RSTB 12 kΩ (R7) to +3V3; IO0, IO2 12 kΩ up (R9, R10), IO15 12 kΩ down (R11); TX 470 Ω (R8); A0 220 kΩ (R12) / 100 kΩ (R13) to TOUT; LED1 with 2 kΩ on IO2; USB-C CC1/CC2 5.1 kΩ to GND (R1, R2); JP1 RST–IO16 through 470 Ω; PCB antenna ANT_PCB_2.4G_15.2MM_F

LOLIN D1 mini product page (wemos.cc/en/latest/d1/d1_mini.html, V4.0.0 current) (read 2026-10-31): 4 MB flash, ESP-8266EX, 11 digital IO, 1 analog input (3.2 V max input), USB-C, LOLIN I2C port, 'All of the IO pins run at 3.3V', size 34.2 × 25.6 mm; pin picture d1_mini_v4.0.0_5_16x9.png (RST, A0, 16, 14 SCK, 12 MISO, 13 MOSI, 15, 3.3V | TX, RX, 5 SCL, 4 SDA, 0, 2 LED, GND, VBUS)

Espressif ESP8266EX Datasheet v7.1 (marked NRND, 2025.11) (documentation.espressif.com, read 2026-10-31): table 2-1 pin definitions and note (GPIO2, GPIO0, MTDO select the boot mode; U0TXD not to be pulled low during power-up), table 4-3 HSPI (GPIO14 CLK, GPIO12 MISO, GPIO13 MOSI, GPIO15 CS), 4.4 I2C in software, table 4-5 I2S (input GPIO12 data, GPIO13 BCK, GPIO14 WS; output GPIO15 BCK, GPIO3 data, GPIO2 WS), table 4-6 UART (UART0 GPIO1/GPIO3, UART1 TX GPIO2), 4.7 PWM in software, table 4-9 ADC (TOUT 0–1.0 V), table 5-1 (VDD 2.5–3.6 V, VIL ≤ 0.25 VIO, VIH ≥ 0.75 VIO up to 3.6 V, IMAX 12 mA), table 5-3 TX current, table 5-4 radio
pin numbers: J2 1–8 as pins 1–8, J3 1–8 as pins 9–16 (the connector order of the schematic) – a footprint must follow this numbering
functions: spi1 = HSPI, uart0/uart1 as table 4-6, i2s0 = the I2S data output, i2s1 = the I2S data input (table 4-5; the datasheet numbers neither) – I2C and PWM are software and left out
i_core_a 0.17 A: TX 802.11b at +17 dBm typ 170 mA, 50 % duty cycle (table 5-3) – assumption: no maximum given
gpio_i_max_a 0.012 A: IMAX of table 5-1; gpio_v_max_v 3.6 V: VIH max of table 5-1
A0 v_max_v 3.2 V and adc.range_v [0, 3.2]: the product page's '3.2V max input' (1.0 V at TOUT behind 220 kΩ / 100 kΩ)
notes: Bought board without an LCSC number, keyed by its model number 'LOLIN D1 MINI' (DoC, RoHS and EMC certificates) with the spaces as '_' (proposed key LOLIN_D1_MINI) – a component names it with part = 'LOLIN D1 MINI' and bom: false. Entry for hardware V4.0.0 (USB-C, CH340C, ME6211C33).

verified.datasheet: LOLIN D1 mini schematic V4.0.0 (sch_d1_mini_v4.0.0.pdf, wemos.cc); Espressif ESP8266EX Datasheet v7.1 (marked NRND, 2025.11)
checked: header pins J2/J3 against the schematic and the product page's pin picture
board pull resistors: RST, IO0, IO2 12 kΩ up; IO15 12 kΩ down; TX 470 Ω series; A0 divider 220 kΩ / 100 kΩ
USB-C CC1/CC2 5.1 kΩ to GND (values.usb_c rd_5k1)
ESP8266EX: VIH 0.75 VIO, VIL 0.25 VIO, IMAX 12 mA, VDD 2.5–3.6 V; HSPI, UART, I2S pins; I2C and PWM in software
radio 2400–2483.5 MHz, PA output 21.5 dBm max (11b)
RoHS certificate FTC26056002-1; EU DoC of 2026-02-07 (RoHS, EMC)
open: strap levels of GPIO0, GPIO2, GPIO15 (MTDO): the datasheet says only that they select the boot mode; the levels are in the ESP8266 Pin List (strapping list), not read – no strap set, the board's 12 kΩ pulls are recorded
footprint: no EasyEDA footprint chosen for the plug-in board (2 × 8 headers, 2.54 mm); its pin numbering must follow J2 = 1–8, J3 = 9–16
order: LOLIN sells through its own shop; no distributor order code read (PARTS.supplier warns about a bom: false part without one)
ME6211C33 (datasheet not read): dropout_v, iq_a, i_out_max_a, VIN range, rth_ja_k_per_w, tj_max_c – vin limits and LIM.t of the on-board LDO stay open
operating temperature of the board: not given (the ESP8266EX alone: –40 … 125 °C)
antenna_dbi of the PCB antenna: not given; antenna keep-out on the carrier board: no footprint frame to place it in
the EU DoC names no radio directive (2014/53/EU) for a board with a Wi-Fi transmitter – for the regulatory review (M-6)
i_core_a is a typical TX current at 50 % duty cycle, not a maximum; CH340C and LED add to it
pwm and i2c: software on the ESP8266EX – a net with fn pwm or i2c on this board is reported by REQ.function (bit-banged: leave fn out)
